items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: And like I was saying earlier, I was telling Harry Allen, this is a little different situation for me

ctx.x: These parties here are almost like you have your own little fan club sometimes. I see all the people come up, and, “I saw you in Sarasota” and, “would you sign this.” It’s a nice situation.

Yeah that’s what happens. It’s nice, and you do run across some of the same people. And like I was saying earlier, I was telling Harry Allen, this is a little different situation for me, this particular party, and some of the things, I mean a lot of the guys, a lot of the

parties I work, they don’t extend this far into more contemporary music than this party is doing. Because again, these people are very opinionated about what style of music they like. And they don’t want it to get over that way. But these guys here are extending the envelope a little bit. But it makes me feel a little bit of a fish out of water because I’m not so sure I fit in with everything that is going on.
